explicit_source_gaps.subject: MV-IA-F024 Pack Lifecycle and Canonical Content Registry
explicit_source_gaps.finding: F020 and F021 reference MV-IA-F024 as a dependency, but no completed F024 feature packet was found in the canonical internal-alpha feature-packet directory during PPIA-13 foundation inventory.
explicit_source_gaps.foundation_rule: Teach only Pack concepts already evidenced by existing pack locks, installed-pack context, source pack/version and entitlement contracts. Do not invent F024-specific lifecycle mechanics, UI, actions or wording.

explicit_source_gaps.subject: Complete user-facing teaching copy
explicit_source_gaps.finding: Existing sources define behavior and support architecture but do not provide the complete PPIA-13 teaching-content library.
explicit_source_gaps.foundation_rule: Later PPIA-13 milestones may author teaching copy when attributable to governed behavior; authored copy remains teaching content, not gameplay/source truth.

authority_rule: Repository evidence and owner decisions outrank project-source support. Teaching content may explain governed behavior but may not create gameplay mechanics, permissions, Pack lifecycle truth, hidden state, entitlement, recovery authority, canonical content or runtime activation.
